findings.measured: 4.57:1 but APCA Lc -31 on Willemstad Dark; Lc -40 on Frankfurt/Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark (4.53/4.56:1); Lc -39 for #91919a on #2b2b2c (4.53:1); 45 is the small-text floor used here
findings.fix: ensureContrast stops at exactly 4.5:1, which on dark backgrounds leaves mid-tone colors at Lc 30 to 40. Add an APCA floor (about |Lc| 45 to 60) in readableCore/withReadableContrast and lift the link, accent and muted colors of these themes in the themes repo.

findings.title: Callout type label (accent colour at 85% opacity) is far below 4.5:1 in 25 of 28 themes
findings.element: Callout type-switcher label (the word 'note', 'tip', 'warning' ...) at the start of every callout header in live preview
findings.fg: var(--cm-lp-callout-accent) = var(--callout-<type>) at opacity .85, e.g. Lavender Haze warning #a18a1e
findings.bg: editor bg flattened with 7% note tint, e.g. Lavender Haze #F3F0F8 + #3868B0 at 7%
findings.themes: 25 of 28 (15 light, 10 dark); 127 of 168 theme x type pairs below 4.5, 46 below 3.0. Only Deep Ocean, Ink Night, Tolaria Dark pass every type. Worst: warning in Lavender Haze, Tolaria Light, Shimmering Focus Light, Sakura, Willemstad Light, Zettlr Bielefeld Light; tip in Zettlr Bordeaux Light, Shimmering/Willemstad Light; caution in all Zettlr Dark themes
findings.measured: 2.26:1 (Zettlr Bordeaux Dark caution), 2.33:1 Lavender Haze warning, 2.34:1 Tolaria Light warning, 2.35:1 Sakura warning; Lavender Haze tip 2.79, quote 2.68; KokoBrain Default note 3.87, important 3.64, caution 3.54. Still 73 pairs under 4.5 at full opacity. APCA Lc 18-49 on the Zettlr and Shimmering/Willemstad Dark themes (e.g. Zettlr Bordeaux Dark caution Lc 18, Willemstad Dark note Lc 27), 41-48 on light warning/tip.
findings.fix: The label is body-size text but reuses the callout hues, which are only guaranteed 3:1 (and only for built-in themes, READABILITY_PAIRS at theme-builder.logic.ts:153). In the app, derive a text colour for the label: mix the accent toward --editor-fg or run it through ensureContrast against the tint to reach 4.5:1, and drop the .85 opacity; keep the raw hue for the border. Optionally raise the callout threshold in READABILITY_PAIRS and fix the shipped hues in the themes repo (warning and tip on light themes, caution on Zettlr dark).

findings.title: Callout title and body text drop below 4.5:1 on the callout tint in 9 themes, including the built-in light default
findings.element: Callout title and body text (rendered in --syntax-quote via tags.quote in highlight-styles.ts:39, upright)
findings.bg: editor bg flattened with 7% note tint (the tint is the same for every callout type)

findings.measured: 4.15:1 Lavender Haze (bare 4.55), 4.18 Zettlr Bielefeld Light, 4.20 Zettlr Berlin/Bielefeld/Frankfurt/KMS Dark (bare 4.53), 4.29 Bordeaux Dark, 4.41 Twilight Violet, 4.49 Tolaria Light. Source mode (per-type tint) goes to 3.93 on the Zettlr Dark family. APCA Lc under 45: KokoBrain Default 44.95, Twilight Violet 37.7, Zettlr Dark family 37.7-38.2.
findings.fix: Quote text is clamped to about 4.5:1 against editorBg only, so any tint tips it under. In the app, either keep the tint from lowering contrast (lower alpha, or let callout text use a colour guaranteed against the tinted surface such as --editor-fg or a quote colour mixed toward it) or make the theme builder's readability pass for syntax.quote target the tinted surface (about 5:1 vs editorBg). Shipped themes in the themes repo need their quote token nudged for the nine listed themes if the app does not change.

findings.title: Mermaid diagram keeps its old theme after a light/dark switch (traced, not run)
findings.element: Mermaid diagram lines, arrowheads and titles drawn directly on the code block bg

findings.bg: --lp-codeblock-bg of the new theme (dark e.g. #1e1e2e, light e.g. #ddd8e8)
findings.themes: Any light to dark or dark to light switch while a diagram is on screen
findings.measured: Stale light SVG on a dark block bg: 1.05-1.28:1; stale dark SVG on a light block bg: 1.01-1.15:1 (computed from mermaid 12.3.0 theme variables). The staleness itself is a code trace: eq() compares only source, the theme compartment reconfigure at MarkdownEditor.svelte:704 does not rebuild widgets, and block-decorator.ts has no theme dependency. The existing test only builds a second widget

findings.title: Source-mode frontmatter and comment text (--syntax-meta) only 3.0-3.3:1 on 9 themes, including both built-ins
findings.element: Frontmatter block text in source mode at body size, plus tags.comment/tags.meta text (HTML comments, comments inside fenced code in source mode)
findings.themes: KokoBrain Default (built-in), Lavender Haze (built-in), Sakura, Twilight Violet, Zettlr Berlin Light, Zettlr Bielefeld Light, Zettlr Bordeaux Light, Zettlr Frankfurt Dark, Zettlr Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark

findings.fix: The builder lifts meta to 3:1 only (theme-builder.logic.ts:201 and the READABILITY_PAIRS entry), which suits an accent but not body-size frontmatter text. Raise the meta pair to 4.5:1 in the builder, or give the frontmatter and comment text its own 4.5:1 token. The Zettlr palettes also set meta to a saturated accent, which the themes repo can adjust.

findings.title: User-created, edited and imported themes bypass every contrast check; the 26 catalog themes have no test or CI contrast gate

findings.element: mergeThemeWithDefaults keeps every token the theme carries verbatim (pickTokens(defaults.ui, partial.ui, derived.ui)) and only lifts the derived value of missing tokens; parseThemeFromImport (theme-editor.logic.ts:281) validates syntax only; ThemeEditor.handleSave (ThemeEditor.svelte:80-83) persists draftColors as is; normalizeAppearance (theme.logic.ts:372) repeats the merge on load; the editor shows no ratio. Catalog packages are lifted at install and load (buildThemeFromPackage) but the 'holds for every pair' test (theme-builder.logic.test.ts:248) loops BUILTIN_THEMES (2 of 28) and koko.brain-themes scripts/build-index.mjs validates schema and ids only
findings.fg: imported mutedForeground #e8e4f0, syntax.link #f0f0ff, destructive #ffcccc (proof run on real code)
findings.themes: Any imported, hand-edited or saved custom theme. Proof: import then merge gives muted on editor 1.11:1, link on editor 1.00:1, destructive on sidebar 1.26:1. All 28 shipped themes pass all 63 READABILITY_PAIRS today (0 failures), so nothing is broken yet, but a regression in the builder would not be caught for 26 themes.
findings.measured: 1.00:1 link on editor after a normal import (b.mts, real parseThemeFromImport + mergeThemeWithDefaults); 0/28 shipped themes fail READABILITY_PAIRS

Themes repo: add a contrast step to pnpm validate that builds each package with the same pairs and fails the PR on any pair the builder had to lift by a large margin or cannot reach.

findings.bg: popover + destructive/20 on dark (#593643 on KokoBrain Default), destructive/10 on light
findings.themes: dark: 13/13 fail, 6 under 3:1 (Zettlr Bordeaux/Berlin/Bielefeld/Frankfurt/KMS Dark, KokoBrain Default); light: 5/15 fail (Sakura, SF Light, Tolaria Light, Willemstad Light, Lavender Haze)

verdicts.measured: %%comment%%, ^block-id and the hard-break arrow use --syntax-meta at 0.5 opacity (--lp-comment and --lp-hard-break are never set). This fails 4.5:1 on all 28 themes and 3:1 on 24. Worst cases: 1.66:1 on Zettlr Bielefeld Light (Lc 27), 1.60:1 on Zettlr Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark, 1.77:1 on KokoBrain Default; best 3.24:1. Link ref def label (editor-fg@0.5): 27/28 fail, 2.29:1. Its URL (@0.5): 28/28 fail, 1.92:1. Revealed marks (processing@0.6): 28/28 below 4.5, 19 below 3. QueryJS table indicator (fg@0.7 on collection bg): 5/28, 3.50:1. QueryJS error details (@0.85): 22/28, 3.10:1 on Lavender Haze and 2.76:1 on Zettlr Bordeaux Dark.
verdicts.reason: Re-traced every rule. Live preview paints no active-line fill (styles.ts:64-80), so the surface is plain editor-bg. Inline comments are user content shown while the line is touched. The numbers match the scout. Owner is app only: themes-repo themes are palettes, and theme-builder derives and lifts meta, so the themes repo needs no change.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix B. In styles.ts, remove the flat opacity from .cm-lp-inline-comment, .cm-lp-block-ref, the hard-break ::after, .cm-lp-link-ref-def, .cm-formatting-block, .cm-lp-qjs-error-details and .cm-lp-qjs-table-nav-indicator. Use the token at full strength, or a color-mix toward editor-bg that stops at 4.5:1 (3:1 for syntax glyphs). Findings 10, 13 and 14 are subsets of this one.

verdicts.measured: Measured on card, the default node surface. Full URL, file error and text placeholder (foreground@0.4): 28/28 fail, 1.96:1 on Zettlr Berlin Light (Lc 38), 2.60:1 worst dark. Empty state (@0.3): 1.62:1. FileNode subpath (@0.5): 27/28, 2.37:1. File picker path and context-menu shortcut (@0.4 on background): 28/28, 1.92:1. Image path and textarea/link-edit placeholders (muted-foreground@0.5): 28/28, 1.99:1 on Tolaria Light. Best case anywhere 3.65:1.
verdicts.reason: The rules are at LinkNode.svelte:184 and 212, FileNode.svelte:154, 177 and 183, TextNode.svelte:108 and 129, ImageNode.svelte:90, CanvasFilePicker.svelte:140 and CanvasContextMenu.svelte:226. Each element inherits foreground or muted-foreground, and the opacity composites it over card or background. Plain muted-foreground passes 4.5:1 on card and on background on all 28 themes.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix A. Use color: var(--muted-foreground) at full strength in place of the opacity values, and remove opacity from the ::placeholder rules.

verdicts.measured: The scout measured the wrong surface: the view root is bg-card (CollectionView.svelte:517), not editor-bg. Re-measured on card: 28/28 fail, 2.35:1 on Tolaria Light (Lc 46), 2.53:1 on Twilight Violet, 2.81:1 on KokoBrain Default, best 3.77:1. Add property (PropertiesView.svelte:235, tab-text-inactive/60 on right-sidebar-bg): 28/28 fail, 2.25:1 on Tolaria Light, 2.75:1 on Zettlr Bordeaux Dark. Both tokens at full strength pass on all 28 themes.
verdicts.reason: Tailwind's /60 is color-mix with transparent, which acts like 60% alpha. Most themes fall below 3:1 in a view the user sees often.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix A. Use text-muted-foreground and text-tab-text-inactive without the alpha modifier, and keep the hover change. Do the same for the Plus icon at PropertiesView.svelte:224.

verdicts.measured: Unresolved rows at opacity-60 on right-sidebar-bg: destructive text fails 28/28, 2.30:1 on Tolaria Light and 1.95:1 on Zettlr Bordeaux Dark. Heading (right-sidebar-muted-fg@0.6): 28/28, 2.25:1. Properties relationship row (PropertiesView.svelte:273, opacity-50): 23/28, 2.30:1 on Zettlr Berlin Light, 3.43:1 worst dark.
verdicts.reason: Container opacity composites both the text and the icon over the sidebar. Even with the opacity removed, --destructive at full strength still fails on 13/28 themes on right-sidebar-bg (3.39:1 on Zettlr Bordeaux Dark). That is the destructive-token root cause scout 01 already reports.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix A. Remove opacity-60 and opacity-50 and mark the unresolved state with the icon, italic or a dashed underline. The remaining red-text failures go away with scout 01's fix: a destructive text pair in READABILITY_PAIRS.

verdicts.measured: muted-foreground/50 on background (Kanban date icons, welcome page): 27/28 below 3:1, 1.94:1 on Tolaria Light (Lc 36), 2.23:1 on Twilight Violet. On popover (SortPanel.svelte:91, PropertiesPanel.svelte:135 and 142, FormulaRow.svelte:91 and 98): 28/28 below 3:1, 1.93:1 on Sakura. Properties '+' icon (/60 on right-sidebar-bg): 21/28 below 3:1.
verdicts.reason: Each icon is the only content of a labelled button: remove date, set date, delete, drag handle. That makes them meaningful non-text UI, so 3:1 applies.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix A. Use text-muted-foreground at full strength (it passes 4.5:1 on background and popover on all 28 themes) and keep the hover to foreground.

verdicts.measured: Kanban filter placeholder and the 'Add a card...' placeholder (KanbanLane.svelte:418, which is not the lane title input) at muted/50 on bg-background: 28/28 fail, 1.94:1 on Tolaria Light, 2.23:1 on Twilight Violet, 2.56:1 on KokoBrain Default. PropertyField.svelte:191 (right-sidebar-muted-fg/30 on input-bg over the sidebar): 28/28 fail, 1.46:1 on Lavender Haze (Lc 19), best 1.91:1.
verdicts.reason: Re-traced: each input has its own bg-background, or bg-input-bg in the Properties list.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix A. Use placeholder:text-muted-foreground (and text-right-sidebar-muted-fg) without alpha, as ui/input.svelte does.

verdicts.measured: editor-fg over lp-collection-bg (flattened over editor-bg): @0.5 fails 22/28 (2.30:1 on Zettlr Berlin Light, 2.72:1 on Lavender Haze, 3.43:1 worst dark); @0.6 fails 15/28; @0.7 fails 5/28 (3.50:1). kpi labels (line 133) sit on their default card tint rgba(160,160,160,0.15), where @0.7 fails 10/28 (3.29:1 on Zettlr Berlin Light).
verdicts.reason: Opacity comes from inline cssText at lines 133, 215, 228, 339, 369 and 390. The kpi card surface is slightly darker than the scout assumed, which makes those labels worse.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix A. Set color to a muted token that already passes on lp-collection-bg (--lp-collection-loading or --muted-foreground; the builder holds collectionLoading to 4.5:1 there) and drop opacity.

verdicts.measured: Chip text at whole-chip alpha over the default chip rgba(139,108,239,0.3) on the collection bg. Alpha 0.4: 28/28 fail, 1.69:1 on Zettlr Berlin Light, best 3.23:1. Alpha 0.7: 15/28 fail. Alpha 1.0: 0/28, minimum 5.22:1.
verdicts.reason: opacity = 0.4 + ratio*0.6 sits on the element, so text and tint fade together.
verdicts.fix: Encode frequency through font size, which is already scaled, and the background alpha only. Keep the chip text at full editor-fg.

verdicts.measured: --lp-task-border against editor-bg: 19/28 below 3:1 and 13/28 below 2:1. 1.50:1 on Zettlr Bielefeld Light, 1.61:1 on Twilight Violet, 1.69:1 on Lavender Haze, 2.02:1 on KokoBrain Default; best 5.10:1 on Lumen Contrast.
verdicts.reason: The border is the whole unchecked control. The builder sets taskBorder: p.faintFg (theme-builder.logic.ts:273) and READABILITY_PAIRS has no taskBorder pair. Themes-repo files are palettes and built-ins also go through buildTheme, so the fix is app-only. The scout's 'all 9 Zettlr light themes' is a miscount (there are 5), but the total of 19 holds.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix C. Add ['preview','taskBorder','ui','editorBg',3] to READABILITY_PAIRS, or derive taskBorder from mutedFg. No themes-repo change is needed.

verdicts.measured: Same numbers as styles.ts:595: 28/28 below 4.5:1, 24/28 below 3:1, 1.60-3.24:1, KokoBrain Default 1.77:1, Lavender Haze 1.70:1.
verdicts.reason: Duplicate of the styles.ts:595 finding, for the same rules.
verdicts.fix: Covered by shared fix B; merge it into the styles.ts:595 finding.

verdicts.measured: Text on lp-highlight-bg flattened over editor-bg. editor-fg: 4/28 fail (3.93:1 on Zettlr Berlin, Bielefeld, Frankfurt and Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark). Strong: 6/28 (3.38:1 on Shimmering Focus Dark). Emphasis: 8/28 (2.97:1 on Twilight Violet, 3.47:1 on Lavender Haze). lp-link: 15/28 below 4.5:1 and 6/28 below 3:1 (1.43:1 on Zettlr Frankfurt Dark), 2.88:1 on KokoBrain Default.
verdicts.reason: highlightBg comes from the palette's highlight (#ffff0060 on the Zettlr dark themes), and no readability pair checks text against it.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix C. Add builder pairs for editorFg, strong, emphasis and link against the flattened highlightBg, adjusting the highlight rather than the text. In the themes repo, lower the alpha or darken the yellow highlight in the Zettlr dark palettes.

verdicts.measured: color-mix(primary 70%, editor-fg) on color-mix(primary 20%, editor-bg): 4.01:1 on Zettlr Bielefeld Light, then 4.14, 4.18, 4.22 and 4.37:1 on the other Zettlr light themes (Lc 55 and up). All other themes pass (minimum 4.55:1 on Twilight Violet).
verdicts.reason: The mix percentages are fixed and never checked against each other.
verdicts.fix: Raise the editor-fg share (for example primary 55%) or lighten the tint on light themes. Under 0.5:1 short, APCA is fine.

verdicts.measured: Label (editor-fg@0.5): 27/28 fail, 12 below 3:1, 2.29:1 on Zettlr Bielefeld Light. URL (syntax-url@0.5): 28/28 fail, 1.92:1 on Zettlr Bordeaux Light and 1.93:1 on Willemstad Dark.
verdicts.reason: linkReferenceHandler (markdown-link-handlers.ts:64-71) dims the line whenever it is not touched, so the line is always visible.
verdicts.fix: Covered by shared fix B; subset of the styles.ts:595 finding.

verdicts.measured: --syntax-processing at 0.6 on editor-bg: 28/28 below 4.5:1 and 19/28 below 3:1, 2.27:1 on Zettlr Bielefeld Light, 2.30:1 on Willemstad Dark, 3.41:1 on KokoBrain Default. If the heading color applied instead, 9/28 would be below 3:1.
verdicts.reason: HeaderMark and QuoteMark are tagged processingInstruction, which is defined last in markdownHighlight, so processing wins over the inherited heading class. The dimming is deliberate, for syntax glyphs on the cursor line only.
verdicts.fix: Covered by shared fix B: replace the flat 0.6 with a mix that keeps at least 3:1.

verdicts.measured: 3.05:1 on Lavender Haze (#ca7536 on #F3F0F8) and 3.01:1 on Sakura (Lc 54). All other themes are at 4.53:1 or above.
verdicts.reason: The numerals are about 15-17px at weight 600, which is not large text. READABILITY_PAIRS holds olMarker to 3:1 (theme-builder.logic.ts:142). Lavender Haze sets olMarker at theme.logic.ts:299; Sakura gets it from its themes-repo palette.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix C. Raise the olMarker pair to 4.5:1, which lifts both themes automatically, or split the numeral and bullet tokens.

verdicts.measured: 1.34:1 on both Shimmering Focus themes, 2.79:1 on KokoBrain Default, and at least 3.28:1 elsewhere.
verdicts.reason: The Shimmering Focus palettes set blockquoteAccent to their border color (#303241 dark), and the builder uses it for blockquoteBorder and the tints (theme-builder.logic.ts:223, 271). Italic quote text still marks the block, so this is low.
verdicts.fix: In the themes repo, set the Shimmering Focus blockquoteAccent to a color with at least 3:1 on editorBg, or remove it so the builder falls back to primary.

verdicts.measured: --syntax-meta on editor-bg: 9/28 below 4.5:1, 3.00-3.33:1 (3.05:1 on KokoBrain Default, 3.00:1 on Zettlr Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark with Lc 27).
verdicts.reason: The pair is deliberately held at 3:1 (theme-builder.logic.ts:138). It only matters where meta colors readable text such as HTML comments; it also feeds the dimmed rules in shared fix B.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix C, optional: raise the meta pair to 4.5:1, or leave it and keep only the wikilink bracket at 3:1. This is an owner decision.

verdicts.measured: Native selection (no drawSelection) flattened over editor-bg. editor-fg: 1/28 fail (3.35:1 on Zettlr Berlin Dark). lp-link and wikilink: 21/28 below 4.5:1 and 4/28 below 3:1 (1.40:1 on Zettlr Berlin Dark); KokoBrain Default link 3.87:1.
verdicts.reason: The selection color comes from the palette's selection (#5aaa50cc on Zettlr Berlin Dark), and no pair checks text against it. The state is transient. I assumed the text keeps its color under ::selection in WebKit and did not render it.
verdicts.fix: Tone down the Zettlr Berlin Dark and Willemstad Dark selection colors in the themes repo. Optionally add a builder pair of editorFg against the flattened selection (shared fix C).

missed.title: Table add-row/add-column '+' button is under 3:1 when revealed
missed.element: The dashed '+' buttons beside a live-preview table (widgets.ts:485, 502). They appear when the table is hovered, and the glyph is the button's only content.
missed.fg: --syntax-meta at opacity 0.6 (--lp-table-add-text is never set), e.g. #cfae8a flattened on Zettlr Bielefeld Light
missed.bg: editor-bg (the button fill is transparent), e.g. #f3f3e8
missed.themes: 17 of 28 (12 light, 5 dark), including KokoBrain Default and Lavender Haze
missed.measured: 1.87:1 on Zettlr Bielefeld Light (Lc 33), 1.80:1 on Zettlr Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark, 1.97:1 on KokoBrain Default, 1.92:1 on Lavender Haze; best 4.08:1 (3:1 required for a control)
missed.fix: Part of shared fix B: reveal the button at full strength, or give it a color mixed toward editor-bg that keeps 3:1, and drop the 0.6 hover opacity.

verdicts.measured: Over the blockquote tint at depth 1: Zettlr Bielefeld Dark 3.88, Bordeaux Dark 4.02, Berlin Dark 4.06, Frankfurt Dark 4.07, Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark 4.14, Bielefeld Light 4.15, Lavender Haze 4.25, Tolaria Light 4.49 (8 themes). At depth 3: Bielefeld Dark 3.40, Lavender Haze 4.01. Zettlr dark APCA Lc about -34 to -38.
verdicts.reason: Blockquote/... maps to tags.quote, so all quote text is var(--syntax-quote) (highlight-styles.ts:39) on the .cm-lp-blockquote tint (styles.ts:219-232). The tint is quote at alpha 0x12/0x17/0x21 over --editor-bg. READABILITY_PAIRS (line 136) clamps quote only against the bare editorBg, where it is about 4.5, so any tint pushes it under. Repo themes run through buildTheme, so a builder fix reaches all 28 themes.
verdicts.fix: Add a ['syntax','quote','preview','blockquoteBg3',4.5] pair (withReadableContrast already flattens the bg over editorBg). This is the same fix as the callout body finding (styles.ts:481).

verdicts.measured: Fails by APCA only. Willemstad Dark #567f83 (links, wikilinks, footnote, ol marker, url, processing): 4.57:1, Lc -31. Frankfurt Dark #5e97c7: 4.53, Lc -40. Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark #eb6a60: 4.56, Lc -40. Zettlr dark #91919a (h6, strikethrough, quote): 4.53, Lc -39. The scout missed two more: Twilight Violet wikilink #9a7bb9 (4.53, Lc -36), its h6 (Lc -40) and its link (Lc -44), and KokoBrain Default url #818cf8 (4.52, Lc -41).
verdicts.reason: ensureContrast stops at exactly 4.5:1. On near-black editors that leaves mid-tone accents at Lc 31 to 44. Willemstad Dark at Lc -31 is the weakest.
verdicts.fix: Add an APCA floor (|Lc| at least 45) to the linkFg, primary and mutedFg lifts in readableCore. Optionally retune Willemstad Dark's link colour in the themes repo.

verdicts.measured: Measured at opacity .85 over the 7% callout-note tint: 127 of 168 theme x type pairs are under 4.5 and 46 are under 3; 25 of 28 themes fail at least one type. Worst: Zettlr Bordeaux Dark caution 2.26 (Lc -18), Lavender Haze warning 2.33, Tolaria Light warning 2.34, Sakura warning 2.35. At full opacity, 71 pairs are still under 4.5.
verdicts.reason: callout-field.ts:176 sets --cm-lp-callout-accent to the raw callout hue, which is guaranteed only 3:1 on editorBg (READABILITY_PAIRS line 152). The label is body-size text at weight 500 and gets an extra 0.85 opacity.
verdicts.fix: Colour the label with color-mix(in oklab, accent 40%, var(--editor-fg)) at opacity 1. Measured worst 4.58 (Bielefeld Light warning) and |Lc| at least 48 on all 168 pairs; a 50% accent mix gives only 4.23. Keep the raw hue for the border.

verdicts.measured: Over the 7% note tint: Lavender Haze 4.15 (4.55 on the bare editor), Zettlr Bielefeld Light 4.18, Zettlr Berlin, Bielefeld, Frankfurt and Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark 4.20, Bordeaux Dark 4.29, Twilight Violet 4.41 (Lc -38), Tolaria Light 4.49. KokoBrain Default 4.70 passes but sits at Lc -44.9.
verdicts.reason: Callout text inherits tags.quote (--syntax-quote). The tint is always callout-note at 7%, because the line style overrides only the border colour. Quote is clamped against the bare editorBg only.
verdicts.fix: This shares the fix with the blockquote finding (theme-builder.logic.ts:272): lift quote against the callout tint as well as blockquoteBg3 in the builder. The alternative is to colour callout body text with --editor-fg.

verdicts.measured: 2.72:1 on Zettlr Bielefeld Light and 2.85:1 on Zettlr Berlin, Bordeaux, Frankfurt and Karl-Marx-Stadt Light. The other 23 themes pass 3:1.
verdicts.reason: I rendered it with CM6 in jsdom. The side -1 chevron widget at markerTo is not wrapped in the quote highlight span, so it inherits --editor-fg from .cm-line (editor-theme.ts:24), as the scout assumed. The glyph is a clickable control, so the 3:1 threshold applies.
verdicts.fix: Raise the resting opacity to .7 (worst case 3.32) or .75 (worst case 3.70).

verdicts.measured: On --lp-codeblock-bg (the .cm-lp-mermaid container): Zettlr Bordeaux Dark 3.39, Zettlr Berlin, Bielefeld, Frankfurt and Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark 3.55, Lavender Haze 3.66, Tolaria Light 3.82, Shimmering Focus Light 3.89, Willemstad Light 3.96, Sakura 3.97. Twilight Violet passes WCAG (4.63) but is Lc -35.5.
verdicts.reason: collectionError = p.error, which readableCore lifts only to 3:1 on editorBg (theme-builder.logic.ts:189). It is never checked on the code block or collection surfaces.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix with styles.ts:660 and CollectionView.svelte:520: lift error to 4.5 on editorBg, panelBg, popoverBg and sidebarBg in readableCore. errorFg is already re-derived against it, so the destructive button stays at 4.5.

verdicts.measured: Traced, not run in the app. Mermaid 12.3.0 default-theme lineColor #333333 on a dark code block bg: 1.05 to 1.52. Dark-theme textColor #ccc on a light code block bg: 1.15 to 1.61.
verdicts.reason: eq() compares only the source (line 132), so CM keeps the old DOM. The theme $effect only reconfigures editorThemeCompartment (MarkdownEditor.svelte:702-713), and there is no {#key} remount. The cache key includes the theme, but an existing widget is never rebuilt. It recovers when the note is reopened, hence low severity.
verdicts.fix: Store the mermaid theme on the widget, compare it in eq(), and pass currentMermaidTheme() when the decoration is built, so a light/dark flip re-renders the diagram. Confirm in the running app first.

verdicts.measured: --syntax-meta on --editor-bg: KokoBrain Default 3.05 (Lc -26), Lavender Haze 3.28, Sakura 3.33, Twilight Violet 3.08 (Lc -24), Zettlr Berlin Light 3.04, Bielefeld Light 3.03, Bordeaux Light 3.06, Frankfurt Dark 3.02, Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark 3.00. The other 19 themes are at 4.5 or better.
verdicts.reason: Source-mode frontmatter is drawn at body size and normal weight in --syntax-meta, which the builder lifts to 3:1 only (readableCore and READABILITY_PAIRS line 138). HTML comments use the same token (highlight-styles.ts:42).
verdicts.fix: Colour frontmatter and comment text with --muted-foreground, which is clamped to 4.5, or raise the meta pair to 4.5. Wikilink brackets also use meta, and a 4.5 meta is fine for them too.

verdicts.measured: On --lp-collection-bg: Zettlr Bordeaux Dark 3.39, Zettlr dark family 3.55, Willemstad Light 3.62, Lavender Haze 3.66, Shimmering Focus Light 3.69, Tolaria Light 3.82, Sakura 3.97, Shimmering Focus Dark 4.42 (11 themes). The same token on the editor bg (math error) measures 3.01 on the Zettlr dark family.
verdicts.reason: Same root cause as the mermaid error (styles.ts:898): the error token is lifted only to 3:1 on editorBg.
verdicts.fix: Use the shared readableCore error lift to 4.5 on all surfaces (see styles.ts:898) instead of a single collectionError pair. Lifting the core keeps error, destructive and the embed error consistent.

verdicts.measured: Day numbers (--editor-fg composited at .35 over the collection bg) measure 1.76 to 3.11. 26 of 28 themes are under 3:1 and all 28 are under 4.5. Event pill text measures 1.72 to 3.11 (APCA Lc 15 to 44).
verdicts.reason: td.style.opacity .35 dims the whole cell, including the clickable event pills.
verdicts.fix: Dim only the day-number div, and keep it at 3:1 or better (for example --muted-foreground with no opacity). Leave the event pills at full contrast.

verdicts.measured: 1.69 to 2.37 in all 28 themes: Zettlr light family 1.69, KokoBrain Default 2.02, best Shimmering Focus Dark 2.37.
verdicts.reason: Fails every theme, but out-of-month dimming is an intentional convention and the cell tint already signals it, so I rated it low rather than medium.
verdicts.fix: Use /70 (or plain muted-foreground) and let the bg-muted/20 cell tint carry the 'other month' cue.

verdicts.measured: Measured on --muted at 60% over --card: Zettlr Berlin, Bielefeld, Frankfurt and Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark 3.26 (Lc -33), Bordeaux Dark 3.32, Twilight Violet 4.12, Zettlr light family 4.20, Tolaria Light 4.46 (12 themes). On plain card the minimum is 4.51.
verdicts.reason: mutedForeground is clamped against card, not against card plus a muted tint. The same pattern is at CollectionLinearCalendarView.svelte:147 and :152.
verdicts.fix: Lower the header tint to bg-muted/30 or drop it, or add a mutedForeground pair against muted. The same fix covers the '+N more' label listed under missed.

verdicts.measured: Swatch fill (barColors().fill) against --card is 1.25 to 1.53 on all 15 light themes (Lavender Haze 1.25 worst) and at least 2.62 on dark themes. 17 of 28 themes have a swatch under 3:1.
verdicts.reason: These are colour keys for the bars, so the 3:1 non-text threshold applies. The text label beside each swatch limits the impact.
verdicts.fix: Add a 1px inset ring to the swatch, using the bar text colour or color-mix toward --foreground.

verdicts.measured: --primary on card: Sakura 4.15, Twilight Violet 4.19, Shimmering Focus Light 4.30. On a hovered row (muted/50): Frankfurt Dark 3.43. The link with primary/80 on a hovered row: Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark 2.70. The month label on the accent hover: Zettlr Berlin Light 2.73. The widget's today number: Sakura 3.73.
verdicts.reason: readableCore lifts primary to 4.5 against editorBg only. The worst cases appear only in transient hover states.
verdicts.fix: In readableCore, lift primary to 4.5 against panelBg and sidebarBg as well. Drop the hover:text-primary/80 and show hover with an underline change instead.

verdicts.measured: 1.99 to 3.02: Tolaria Light 1.99, Zettlr light family 2.00. 27 of 28 themes are under 3.
verdicts.reason: The em dash is an intentional empty-cell marker and the cell itself signals emptiness, so the severity is low.
verdicts.fix: Use /70 or plain muted-foreground.

verdicts.measured: Error panel (destructive on destructive/10 over card): Zettlr Berlin, Bielefeld, Frankfurt and Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark 2.79 (Lc -25). 14 of 28 themes are under 4.5 and 5 are under 3. verdicts.measured: color() text on --card, light themes: yellow 1.56, green 1.98, orange 2.08, gray 2.13, blue 2.49. Shares root C (tokens lifted against editorBg only) with findings 5 and 16.

verdicts.measured: --input border vs --popover: 1.06 Sakura, 1.24 KokoBrain Default, 1.49 Graphite Violet, 1.51 Lavender Haze, 1.67 Zettlr light x5, 1.81 Zettlr dark x5, 2.70 Willemstad Dark; only Lumen Contrast 4.29 and Willemstad Light 3.95 reach 3:1. Border vs the bg-background fill 1.07 to 3.83

verdicts.fix: Clamp borderStrong to 3:1 against popoverBg and editorBg in buildTheme (note it also feeds switchUncheckedBg), or give these inputs a stronger border token. One builder change fixes every shadcn border-input site.

verdicts.measured: muted-foreground/50 on popover 1.95 (Sakura) to 2.96 (Willemstad Light), all 28 under 3:1; on accent hover row 1.66 to 2.82. At /70 12 themes still fail (2.78 Tolaria Light, 2.83 Zettlr light); plain muted-foreground is 4.51+ everywhere
verdicts.reason: Always-visible icon-only edit/remove buttons (PropertiesPanel 135,142; FormulaRow 91,98) and the drag handle (SortPanel 91) with no text label, at half alpha.

verdicts.measured: --lp-collection-error on --lp-collection-bg: Zettlr Bordeaux Dark 3.39 (Lc-27), Zettlr Berlin/Bielefeld/Frankfurt/KMS Dark 3.55, Willemstad Light 3.62, Lavender Haze 3.66, SF Light 3.69, Tolaria Light 3.82, Sakura 3.97, SF Dark 4.42 (11 themes). The stack on --lp-codeblock-bg fails the same set, and the details text at opacity .85 is 2.76 worst
verdicts.reason: collectionError = p.error (theme-builder.logic.ts:283), and readableCore lifts error only to 3:1 on editorBg (line 187). collectionBg (= sidebarBg) is never tested.
verdicts.fix: Shared root A with finding 14: lift the error text color to 4.5 on editorBg, popoverBg and sidebarBg/collectionBg in readableCore, and add collectionError on collectionBg to READABILITY_PAIRS. Drop the .85 opacity on the details text.

verdicts.measured: --lp-wikilink on collection bg: Sakura 3.79, SF Light 4.08, Willemstad Dark 4.18, Zettlr Berlin Light 4.19, Bordeaux Light 4.29, KMS Light 4.32, Lavender Haze 4.41; the same colors on editor-bg are 4.52 to 5.45
verdicts.reason: The class is used by kb-api.ts:509 for kb.link output in QueryJS blocks. READABILITY_PAIRS tests preview.wikilink only on editorBg (line 140).
verdicts.fix: Add preview wikilink (and preview link) on collectionBg to READABILITY_PAIRS. This is root C, shared with findings 1 and 16. The builder rebuilds every theme at load, so no themes-repo change is required.

verdicts.measured: Zettlr Berlin Light 4.51 Lc33, hover 4.16 Lc30 (fails WCAG); Willemstad Dark 4.51 Lc33; Twilight Violet 4.95 Lc39; Zettlr Frankfurt Dark 4.54 Lc41; KMS Dark 4.56 Lc41. White on the same fills is Lc-63 to -77
verdicts.reason: --lp-meta-bind-btn-primary-text = --primary-foreground (app.css:456). primaryFg is pushed to near-black by ensureContrast (theme-builder.logic.ts:194), and the hover color-mix toward editor-fg (app.css:457) is never checked. These are palette-built themes, so the cause is in the builder, not the themes repo.
verdicts.fix: Same fix as finding 15 (root B): choose primaryForeground by APCA the way labelColors does, and check the hover mix at 4.5:1.

verdicts.measured: editor-fg at .6 over each default step flattened on the block: red step fails 28/28, amber/yellow/lime/green 27/28, gray 19/28. Worst 1.87 SF Dark (green), 2.13 Zettlr light x5 (red)
verdicts.reason: The label inherits editor-fg (editor-theme.ts:24) at opacity 0.6 over a fixed translucent cell. It is unreadable wherever a label is passed, but only in this opt-in widget, so medium rather than high.
verdicts.fix: Root D: drop the opacity, and set the cell text (value and label) per cell with labelColors(flattened cell color), or derive the scale from theme vars.

verdicts.measured: Value text (editor-fg, bold ~14px) fails the green step on 11 dark themes (SF Dark 2.80 Lc-43, Zettlr Bordeaux Dark 2.89, Twilight Violet 3.15, Zettlr dark 4.25), lime on 6, yellow on 7, amber on 5, and red on Zettlr light x5 at 3.83
verdicts.reason: DEFAULT_HEATMAP_COLORS is a fixed rgba scale that ignores the theme, and the text inherits editor-fg. Below threshold in a rare, opt-in widget.
verdicts.fix: Same per-cell labelColors fix as finding 7 (root D).

verdicts.measured: Stale #000 on dark collection bg 1.14 to 1.39, #fff on light 1.08 to 1.39. Traced in code, not run in the app
verdicts.reason: isDark is read once at render (lines 608, 1018). The session cache is keyed by path + jsContent, and toDOM re-attaches the cached live element (queryjs-block-widget.ts:135-138). Nothing in queryjs reads appliedThemeStore, and the editor theme reconfigure (MarkdownEditor.svelte:703-713) does not rebuild it. Low because it only follows a manual light/dark switch (no follow-system mode exists) and clears on the next content invalidation.
verdicts.fix: Resolve chart text, point and empty-cell colors from CSS vars at paint time and update the charts on appliedThemeStore change, or clear the QueryJS results when the dark flag flips.

verdicts.measured: rgb(61,61,61) border vs the #333 empty cell is 1.16 on all 13 dark themes, and 1.39 to 1.70 vs the block bg. Light themes pass (9.26)
verdicts.reason: Same at line 893. It is the only today indicator, and on by default (showCurrentDayBorder).
verdicts.fix: Draw it with a theme var (--editor-fg or --ring) as an outline with offset, so it contrasts with both the cell and the block in both modes.

verdicts.measured: Light: level 1 vs block 1.01 (Lavender Haze) to 1.31, level 1 vs the empty cell 1.20, empty vs block 1.01 to 1.19. Dark: level 5 #196127 vs block 1.99 to 2.44 and vs the #333 empty cell 1.67, so on dark themes the busiest days are the least visible
verdicts.reason: A GitHub white-page palette with emptyColor hard-coded at line 1019.
verdicts.fix: Root D: derive the empty cell and the default scale from --lp-collection-bg toward a hue and --editor-fg, ensuring 3:1 for the top level and between empty and level 1; optionally run user palettes through ensureContrast against the block.

verdicts.measured: Lavender Haze: yellow 1.38, green 1.74, orange 1.83, gray 1.88, blue 2.19. All 15 light themes are under 3:1 for these five; dark themes pass
verdicts.reason: ds.color is required and user supplied, so only the documented examples (help/documentation/13-queryjs.md:975-1003) are at stake. The docs live in this repo, so the owner is app, not both.
verdicts.fix: Use darker example colors in the docs. Optionally run series colors through ensureContrast(color, block bg, 3) in expandDataset.

verdicts.measured: The stripe flattened over the block is 1.00 to 1.01 on all 15 light themes and 1.07 to 1.10 on dark
verdicts.reason: White at 3% alpha does nothing on light surfaces. The scout's suggested token --lp-collection-table-alt also flattens to 1.00 to 1.06 on 22 themes (see missed), so it is not a working fix.
verdicts.fix: Use color-mix(in oklab, var(--editor-fg) 5-6%, var(--lp-collection-bg)) for the stripe, and use the same fix for the collection table zebra.

verdicts.measured: Badge (destructive on destructive/10 over editor-bg) fails on 15 themes: Zettlr Berlin/Bielefeld/Frankfurt/KMS Dark 2.78 (Lc-25), Zettlr Bordeaux Dark 2.95, KokoBrain Default 3.19 (Lc-31), SF Light 3.53. EventForm errors on popover fail on 12: Bordeaux Dark 2.96, KokoBrain Default 3.02, Zettlr dark 3.11. Load error on editor-bg (text-sm, not text-xs) fails on 10: Zettlr dark 3.01, KokoBrain Default 3.44. Trash icon under 3:1 only on Zettlr Bordeaux Dark 2.96
verdicts.reason: readableCore lifts error to only 3:1 (theme-builder.logic.ts:187) while it is used as 4.5 text. KokoBrain Default is built by the same builder (theme.logic.ts:117).
verdicts.fix: Root A, shared with finding 4: lift the error text form to 4.5 on editorBg, popoverBg and sidebarBg. Simulation shows the badge still sits at 3.97 on Zettlr Berlin Dark after that lift, so the badge also needs its own change: text-foreground on the tint, or check the error against the tinted fill.

verdicts.measured: WCAG 4.51 to 4.95, but APCA Lc33 on Willemstad Dark and Zettlr Berlin Light, Lc39 Twilight Violet, Lc41 Zettlr Frankfurt and KMS Dark. White on the same fills is Lc-63 to -77. The navigator (CalendarGrid.svelte:60, file-explorer-primary) fails the same 5
verdicts.reason: theme-builder.logic.ts:194: ensureContrast(primaryFg, primary, 4.5) moves the label to near-black on mid-tone fills, which is the owner's black-on-saturated-badge class. labelColors(primary) gives white at Lc-76/-77, but its darkened fill drops to 3.13 to 4.57 vs the editor.
verdicts.fix: Root B, shared with finding 6 and every bg-primary + text-primary-foreground use: pick primaryForeground by APCA, and add a separate fill token darkened to 4.5 under white, because the text-primary token must keep its 4.5 against the editor.

verdicts.measured: muted-fg on muted fails on 14 themes (Zettlr Bordeaux Dark 2.52, Zettlr dark 2.58, Twilight Violet 3.87, Zettlr light 3.68). primary on muted (today hover) fails on 15 (Frankfurt Dark 2.58, KMS Dark 2.60, Berlin Dark 2.96, Berlin Light 3.33). Navigator weekend file-explorer-primary on file-explorer-accent fails on 11 (Zettlr Berlin Light 2.73, Bordeaux Light 2.80)
verdicts.reason: The hover fills (muted = p.hover, accent = p.selected) are never paired with mutedFg or primary in readableCore or READABILITY_PAIRS. Themes are rebuilt from the palette at load, so this is owned by the builder.
verdicts.fix: Root C: add mutedForeground and primary on muted, and fileExplorerPrimary on fileExplorerAccent, to the builder pairs, or use a lighter hover fill (a mix of muted into editor-bg) in these components.

verdicts.measured: primary vs editor-fg (the neighbouring day numbers) is under 3:1 on 26/28 themes: Zettlr Bordeaux Dark 1.08, Deep Ocean 1.22, SF Dark 1.32

verdicts.measured: Dot and selected fill are both bg-file-explorer-primary: 1.00:1 on 28/28 themes
verdicts.reason: The picked day defaults to today (day-lens.logic.ts:25), so today's count dots vanish. Severity is low because the day lens lists that day's notes directly, so the information is still on screen.
verdicts.fix: While the day is selected, draw the dots with the label color (bg-primary-foreground).

verdicts.measured: Preset text on its own 15% tint, flattened. On editor-bg: red 27/28, purple 27/28, blue 25/28, gray 22/28, green 21/28, orange 21/28, yellow 15/28 (all 15 light themes fail every preset). Worst is yellow at 1.51 on Sepia (Lc 20). On lp-collection-bg: yellow 1.29 on Lavender Haze (Lc 11), green 1.60, blue 1.96. Dark: KokoBrain Default purple 2.95, red 3.13, blue 3.54.

verdicts.measured: Raw preset on the bare surface. On editor-bg: purple 25/28, red 24/28, blue 17/28; green, orange, yellow and gray fail all 15 light themes. Yellow 1.63 on Sepia, 1.38 on Lavender Haze with lp-collection-bg. Dark: KokoBrain Default red 3.58, purple 3.53, blue 4.42.

verdicts.fix: Shared fix A: the same foreground-mixed preset as badge(), at about 25/75. On the bare surface the 30/70 mix already measured 4.51 or better.

verdicts.measured: The percent label rgb(160,160,160) fails 15/15 light themes: 2.22 on Sepia (editor-bg, Lc 40) and 1.88 on Lavender Haze (lp-collection-bg). Bar against the surface (3:1): yellow 1.63, green 2.06 (15 light), blue 2.59 (8 light). Dark themes pass.

verdicts.measured: text-primary on primary/10 over list-bg. Row at rest: 10/28 fail (8 light, 2 dark), worst Twilight Violet 3.49 (Lc -32), Willemstad Dark 3.77, Shimmering Focus Light 3.78. Hovered row: 18/28 fail, worst 3.08. Active row (pill on primary/25): 26/28 fail, worst 2.53. KokoBrain Default is 4.97 at rest and 3.20 on an active row.
verdicts.reason: Confirmed. Bare primary on list-bg already fails 7/28 (3.97 Twilight Violet), so the 10% pill tint only adds to an existing shortfall.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix B: draw the pill text in foreground mixed with primary (as the editor tag pill does), not in raw primary. In the themes repo, lift primary on list-bg for Twilight Violet, Willemstad Dark, Shimmering Focus Light, Sakura and the Zettlr light themes.

verdicts.measured: right-sidebar-primary on right-sidebar-bg fails on 7 of 28 themes (5 light, 2 dark): 4.08 Shimmering Focus Light, 4.15 Sakura, 4.18 Willemstad Dark, 4.19 Twilight Violet. Both built-ins pass (5.55).
verdicts.reason: The heading sits on bg-right-sidebar-bg (AppShell.svelte:277). At 15px semibold it is not large text, so it needs 4.5:1.
verdicts.fix: Lift right-sidebar-primary to 4.5 on those themes, and add a rightSidebarPrimary-on-rightSidebarBg pair to READABILITY_PAIRS.

verdicts.measured: The foreground ring against the swatch it encloses fails 3:1 on all 13 dark themes for orange, yellow, green, cyan and purple: yellow 1.07 on Deep Ocean, cyan 1.03 on Shimmering Focus Dark, green 1.21, orange 1.40, purple 1.72. Red fails 12/28. The ring against the popover passes everywhere (min 7.97).
verdicts.reason: The border is transparent at rest and the swatch background paints under it. Activating the swatch only recolors its outer 2px from the swatch color to foreground, which on dark themes is nearly the same luminance. Severity is low because the popover is rarely opened and the row's TagColorDot already shows the chosen color.
verdicts.fix: Separate the ring from the fill: background-clip padding-box with a transparent gap, or an offset box-shadow ring. The ring is then judged against the popover (7.97 or more).

verdicts.measured: The custom swatch fill rgba(255,255,255,0.1) against the popover is 1.00 on all 15 light themes and 1.33-1.38 on dark themes (KokoBrain Default 1.36): 28/28 fail. The none dot's X icon passes (min 3.30).
verdicts.reason: With no tag color set, the custom-color control has no border and no glyph. On light themes it is invisible, and it is the only way to pick an arbitrary color.
verdicts.fix: Give the empty custom swatch a visible outline from foreground or border tokens, or a plus or pipette glyph. Replace the white rgba hover border and the none fill with foreground-based tokens.

verdicts.measured: muted-foreground on accent fails 11/28: 3.02 (Lc 43) on all 5 Zettlr light themes, Lavender Haze 4.20. At rest on editor-bg the minimum is 4.52. The tag name in foreground on accent passes (min 4.76).
verdicts.reason: Applies only while the row is hovered. The cause is the dark #c8c8c8 accent token on the Zettlr light themes.
verdicts.fix: Lighten accent on the Zettlr light family, and add a mutedForeground-on-accent pair to READABILITY_PAIRS.

verdicts.measured: Builder pair (type-* on fe-bg) passes everywhere (min 3.39). On the selected nav tint, each hue fails 10-13 of 28 themes: red 2.11 on Zettlr Bordeaux Dark, pink 2.42, yellow and orange 2.28 on Willemstad Light. On the selected list tint: red 1.94 on Bordeaux Dark, pink 2.22. KokoBrain Default red 2.50 (nav), 2.29 (list). Organize check in type-green: 8/28 fail on the plain row (2.88 Tolaria Light) and 15/28 on an active row (1.98 Willemstad Light).
verdicts.reason: iconColorStyle and IconRenderer keep the _color on active rows, so the icon sits on the 25% primary tint. The builder only tests these tokens on fe-bg.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix B: add the selected-tint surface to the TYPE_PALETTE_TOKENS pairs, or have the app soften the selected tint under colored icons. Color the organize check by contrast with the surface it sits on, or keep it in foreground on active rows.

verdicts.measured: Raw hex used as title text (4.5:1). On list-bg: Purple 25/28 fail, Red 24/28, Blue and Pink 19/28 each; Yellow, Green, Cyan and Orange fail all 15 light themes (Yellow 1.47 on Sepia nav-bg, Green 1.75, Cyan 1.87). Dark: KokoBrain Default list-bg Purple 3.64, Red 3.83, Blue 3.92. EditorTabs.svelte:232 also applies the same titleColor to tab titles: Yellow 1.47 on Sepia tab-bar, Purple 3.36 on Sepia editor-bg.
verdicts.reason: titleColor is applied raw via style:color in FilesNavigator:566, TypesNavigator:294/:424, NoteRow:127 and EditorTabs:232, bypassing iconColorCss.
verdicts.fix: Store type palette names and resolve title colors through iconColorCss, plus a contrast lift against the row or tab surface (ensureContrast to 4.5). Shares root cause C with the tag dots.

verdicts.measured: primary on primary/25 over list-bg fails 21/28 (13 light, 8 dark): Twilight Violet 2.82 (Lc -28), Zettlr Karl-Marx-Stadt Light 3.10, Sakura 3.11, KokoBrain Default 3.70, Lavender Haze 4.01. fe-primary on the nav tint fails 20/28: Shimmering Focus Light 2.97, KokoBrain Default 4.05. file-explorer-fg on either tint passes everywhere (min 5.03 nav, 5.24 list).
verdicts.reason: The selected row is always on screen and fails on both built-in themes. A lighter tint does not fix it: at 0.12 the primary text still fails 12/28.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix B: draw the selected label in file-explorer-fg, which passes on all themes. Keep primary for the icon or a side bar. Add a primary-on-selected-tint pair to the builder.

verdicts.measured: Selected nav tint: fe-muted-fg and badge-fg counts fail 21/28, KokoBrain Default 3.08 (Lc -32), Lavender Haze 3.15. Subtitle in muted-foreground on the selected list tint fails 22/28: Zettlr Bielefeld Dark 2.96, KokoBrain Default 3.42. Hover: counts 12/28 (Lavender Haze 3.92), subtitle 10/28 (Twilight Violet 3.75). At rest the counts sit at exactly 4.50 minimum.
verdicts.reason: The muted tokens have zero headroom on the base surface, so any tint breaks them. A 0.12 tint still fails 14-15/28, and mixing muted 50% toward fg still fails 5-7/28 on the Zettlr light themes.
verdicts.fix: Shared fix B: on selected rows, draw counts and subtitles in foreground, or reduce opacity of a foreground color rather than the muted token. In builder and themes repo, give muted tokens headroom (about 5:1 on base) or add tint pairs.

verdicts.measured: The 18% item-color tint against rail-bg is 1.06 (favorites, Sepia) to 1.45 on all 28 themes. Hover fg/10 is 1.15-1.32, so selected looks no different from hover.
verdicts.reason: In the collapsed rail the tint is the only visual cue. Severity is low because the open navigator pane next to it also identifies the active item.
verdicts.fix: Add a 3:1 marker for the active item, such as a side bar or ring in file-explorer-fg or primary, or make the tint clearly stronger than the hover state.

verdicts.measured: ring at 50% fails 3:1 on 24/28 themes (all light, 9 dark) on rail, nav, list and tab-bar: 1.80 on Zettlr Bielefeld Light rail, KokoBrain Default 2.76. Over the selected tint it fails 28/28 (1.67-2.76). Full-strength ring on rail-bg passes (min 3.62).
verdicts.reason: button.svelte already uses full ring-ring for focus-visible. The hand-written rows (Rail, FilesNavigator, TypesNavigator, NoteRow) and the RailNoteList toolbar still use ring-ring/50.
verdicts.fix: Use full-strength ring-ring on these rows, matching Button. On selected rows, offset the ring or draw it as an outline outside the tint (full ring on the list tint still fails on Twilight Violet at 2.82).

verdicts.measured: tab-text-active against tab-text-inactive is 1.25 (Shimmering Focus Dark) to 2.74 on all 28 themes. KokoBrain Default 1.45, Lavender Haze 1.64. Each color alone passes on tab-bar.
verdicts.reason: An active filter, archived scope, property selection or custom sort is shown only by this color shift, and hover uses the same color as the on state. Notes hidden by a filter give no visible cue.
verdicts.fix: Add a non-color on-state marker (a dot, a count, or a filled background such as bg-file-explorer-accent) and keep the hover state distinct from on.

verdicts.measured: file-explorer-muted-fg on popover: KokoBrain Default 3.71 (Lc -35). All other themes pass. muted-foreground on popover passes everywhere (min 4.51).

verdicts.measured: border vs panel 1.06 KokoBrain Default, 1.13 Tolaria Light, max 2.06; select chevron (muted-fg at 50%) 1.94 Tolaria Light to 2.90; switch track vs panel 1.25 Twilight Violet, 1.28 Sakura, 1.32 Tolaria Light, 1.38 Lavender Haze; light-theme thumb (bg-background) vs track 1.28 Sakura, 1.31 Tolaria Light, 1.38 Lavender Haze, about 1.53 Zettlr light

verdicts.measured: label on node (muted-foreground) 1.12 Shimmering Focus Dark, 1.25 Zettlr light, 1.61 KokoBrain Default; label on the active node (primary) 1.05 Zettlr Bielefeld Dark, 1.07 Deep Ocean; label on bg alone passes (5.66 or more)

verdicts.measured: accent vs popover 1.00:1 on all 5 Zettlr dark themes (selected == popoverBg == #282832 in themes/zettlr-*-dark.json), 1.01 Willemstad Dark, 1.06 Sakura, 1.12 Tolaria Light, 1.24 KokoBrain Default, best 1.67 Zettlr light

App: give the selected row a non-color cue (primary leading bar or inset ring) in command-item, dropdown-menu-item, context-menu-item and editor-theme autocomplete, and add a selected-vs-popover floor in theme-builder.

verdicts.measured: worst type token on accent: 2.23 Zettlr light (yellow), 2.51 Zettlr Bielefeld Light (teal), 2.80 Lavender Haze (orange), 2.83 Shimmering Focus Light, 2.85 Shimmering Focus Dark (blue), 2.92 Sakura (green), 2.96 Zettlr Bordeaux Dark (red, also 2.96 on plain popover)

TasksView:955, GraphControls:121 and KanbanView/Lane share the same fix.

verdicts.measured: muted-foreground on muted fails on 14/28: Zettlr dark 2.52 (Bordeaux), 2.58 (others), Lc 27-28; Zettlr light 3.68; Twilight Violet 3.87 (Lc 36); Tolaria Light 4.15; Lavender Haze 4.20 (file-explorer-muted-fg 3.68); Sakura 4.26.

Do not just lift mutedForeground: on Zettlr Bordeaux Dark ensureContrast lands at #c2c2c7, which is 1.06:1 from foreground and makes muted read the same as body text. Derive muted (and activeLineGutter) from the surface in theme-builder so mutedForeground keeps 4.5:1 on it, and add a [mutedForeground, muted] check. For the pills, text-foreground on bg-muted is the cheap app-side fallback.

verdicts.measured: Shortcut (foreground at .4 on --background): 28/28 under 4.5, light 1.92 (Zettlr light), dark 2.68-3.67, KokoBrain Default 3.57, Lc 19.5-49.5. Picker path on hover: 1.91-3.53. Image path (muted at .5 on card): 28/28, 1.99-3.02.

verdicts.measured: Menu border rgba(255,255,255,.15) on background: 1.01 Sakura, 1.02 Lavender Haze, dark max 1.63. Input edge vs its .05 fill: 1.01-1.63, 28/28. Uncolored node border on card: 1.00 on light themes. Menu hover fill: 1.01-1.28.

verdicts.measured: Preset as edge or border vs card: orange, yellow, green, cyan and purple fail 3:1 on 15/15 light themes; red fails only on Lavender Haze and Sakura; min 1.15 yellow Lavender Haze. Swatch vs background: min 1.09 yellow Sepia. Dark: all pass (min 3.48 Graphite Violet).
verdicts.reason: The fixed Obsidian palette is tuned for dark canvases and is used raw in canvas.logic.ts:168 (edge stroke), TextNode/LinkNode border-color and ColorPicker.svelte:31.

Resolve the preset per theme at render time (resolveColor plus ensureContrast against --card, or a labelColors-style OKLab darkening) for strokes, borders and swatches, keeping the stored preset number.

verdicts.measured: Blockquote (syntax-quote on lp-blockquote-bg over card plus 12.5% preset): 20/28 themes fail, worst 2.87 Zettlr Bielefeld Dark yellow (Lc 30.5); 8 themes fail even uncolored. verdicts.measured: #999 (style.css:324) on rgba(255,255,255,.5) over card: dark 1.02-1.26 (KokoBrain Default 1.02), light 2.59-2.85. With colorMode dark the default bg would be rgba(150,150,150,.25), still 12/13 dark under 4.5 (2.90-4.57).

verdicts.measured: Willemstad Dark: every link, wikilink, footnote and URL token is #567f83 on #070707, 4.57:1 but APCA Lc-31. The raw palette primary #0d5257 is 2.27:1. Zettlr Frankfurt Dark #5e97c7 4.53 Lc-40; Zettlr Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark #eb6a60 4.56 Lc-40; Twilight Violet wikilink #9a7bb9 4.53 Lc-36 and link #7898c8 5.46 Lc-44; Zettlr Bordeaux Dark wikilink-heading 4.58 Lc-39. Also under Lc45: KokoBrain Default syntax-url 4.52 Lc-41 and Graphite Violet wikilink-heading 4.80 Lc-43. Light themes are fine.
verdicts.reason: Traced readableCore: lift(p.primary, 4.5) uses ensureContrast, which stops at the first 1% step that clears 4.5:1. On near-black or dark-gray editors that lands on a mid tone, which APCA rates poorly. Passes WCAG 2 and reads poorly by APCA, as the scout said. The editor text is 16px body text.
verdicts.fix: Shared root A. In readableCore, give accent text on dark editors an APCA floor (|Lc| >= 60; for these palettes that is about 6-7:1 WCAG, e.g. Frankfurt Dark #83afd5-#96bbdb, Willemstad Dark #7f9ea1 for Lc-47 or lighter). Apply it to primary/linkFg/wikilink. The builder change alone fixes all 28 themes. Changing linkFg in the repo palettes is optional.

verdicts.measured: Zettlr Bielefeld Light: cyan 4.06, green 4.10, orange 4.15, pink 4.31, blue 4.36, purple 4.40. Zettlr Berlin/Frankfurt/Karl-Marx-Stadt Light: green 4.48, cyan 4.44. Zettlr Bordeaux Light: 4.46/4.43. All other themes pass. APCA Lc 57-64, so this is a WCAG-only miss.

verdicts.measured: Out-of-month days (file-explorer-muted-fg/40 on nav-bg): 1.67 Lavender Haze to 2.42, 28/28 under 3. KanbanDatePicker outside days (muted/40 on popover): 1.68-2.37. verdicts.measured: rgba(preset, 0.15) over the lane (muted/30 over editor-bg). Muted-foreground (checked text, preview) fails on 18/28: Zettlr dark yellow 2.87 (#91919a on #514930), Bordeaux Dark 3.02, Twilight Violet 3.38, Bielefeld Light red 3.55, KokoBrain Default yellow 3.94. In the app, add a non-color cue (a left bar in primary) to the selected suggestion row, the same fix as for the shadcn menus.

verdicts.measured: faintFg on collection-bg fails on 27/28 themes: Sakura 1.33, Lavender Haze 1.37, Zettlr Light 1.53, Twilight Violet 1.75, Tolaria Light 1.92, KokoBrain Default 2.46, Zettlr Dark 2.09. Only Lumen Contrast passes (4.55).

In the app, add editorFg, strong, emphasis, link and wikilink against the flattened highlight to READABILITY_PAIRS, lowering the highlight alpha, not the text, when they fail.

verdicts.measured: Destructive hover (destructive 85% + editor-fg 15%): 3.16:1 (Lc25) on Willemstad Light, 3.84 on Shimmering Focus Light, 3.87 on Tolaria Light, 3.66 on Zettlr Berlin/Bielefeld/Frankfurt/KMS Dark, 4.12 on Bordeaux Dark. verdicts.measured: WCAG passes; APCA does not. mutedFg on Zettlr Dark themes (x5): 4.53-4.68:1, Lc39-42 on editor-bg, card and background. Twilight Violet: 4.51-5.32, Lc38-40. Also KokoBrain Default status-bar-fg 4.50 at Lc37, and its popover muted text Lc44.

verdicts.measured: Active row bg = list-bg + primary/25. verdicts.measured: <mark> in FTS/hybrid snippets, file-explorer-muted-fg on lp-highlight-bg over list-bg: 15/28 under 4.5. 1.60:1 (Lc 15) on Zettlr Berlin/Bielefeld/Frankfurt/Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark, 2.42 on KokoBrain Default (built-in default), 2.65 Willemstad Dark, 2.73 Twilight Violet, 3.45 Graphite Violet, 3.65 Lavender Haze.

verdicts.measured: In Settings (20% tint over setting-item-bg): stable 15/28 (Lavender Haze 3.13, Lc 43), nightly 15/28 (Lavender Haze 3.16), preview 23/28 (5 under 3), dev 19/28. In the welcome footer (over card): stable 21/28 (Lavender Haze 3.50), nightly 16/28, preview 19/28.

verdicts.measured: Outline border (border in light, input under .dark) vs setting-item-bg is under 3 on 28/28: 1.06 Sakura, 1.08 Lavender Haze, 1.09 KokoBrain Default, best 2.80 Willemstad Dark. In light themes bg-background equals setting-item-bg (both palette sidebarBg), so the fill is 1.00.

verdicts.measured: WCAG passes everywhere for row descriptions and dialog text, but APCA is under Lc 45 on 6-7 dark themes: Twilight Violet 4.51:1 Lc 38 (dialog), Zettlr dark 4.53:1 Lc 39, KokoBrain Default 4.61:1 Lc 44, Twilight Violet description 5.32:1 Lc 40. The settings nav group labels also fail WCAG on Twilight Violet (4.27:1), reported under missed.
verdicts.reason: readableCore lifts mutedFg to the WCAG 4.5 floor only, and dark mid-gray at 11-12px reads weak by APCA. This is reported as APCA, not as a WCAG failure.
verdicts.fix: In readableCore, also require an APCA floor (about Lc 45-50) when lifting mutedFg for dark themes. The Zettlr dark and Twilight Violet palettes can set a lighter mutedFg.

verdicts.measured: Active My People row (file-explorer-accent): muted days 11/28 under 4.5 (Zettlr light 3.02, Lc 43), warning days 12/28 (3.05). Weekend day on hover (CalendarGrid.svelte:58,60) 11/28 (Zettlr Berlin Light 2.73). Today on hover:bg-muted 15/28 (Zettlr Frankfurt Dark 2.58). Property type trigger on hover (PropertiesView.svelte:176) 10/28 (Zettlr light 2.77).

verdicts.measured: Tag presets vs popover and right-sidebar on light themes: yellow 1.09-1.41, cyan 1.24-1.62, green 1.55-2.02, orange 1.80-2.34, purple 2.21-2.88, red 2.65-3.45. verdicts.fix: Share the fix with the Zettlr palette and builder findings: a lighter hover/selected fill in the Zettlr palettes, plus lifting mutedFg and primary against the hover and selected surfaces in readableCore. A quicker app-side option is a lower-alpha hover tint (bg-accent/30).

verdicts.measured: muted-foreground on editor-bg passes WCAG but is APCA-weak on 6/28 dark themes: 4.53-4.87 at Lc 39 on Twilight Violet and the 5 Zettlr Dark themes. The chips are 11px (text-label).
verdicts.reason: readableCore lifts mutedFg exactly to 4.5:1. On dark themes that leaves the text at Lc 39, which is weak for 11px chips. Priority is shown only by this muted chip.
verdicts.fix: Same root cause as the StatusBar and primary APCA findings. Give the builder a stronger floor for muted text on dark themes (about Lc 45, or 5:1), or show overdue, due and priority chips in foreground.

verdicts.measured: primary on editor-bg is APCA-weak on 4/28 dark themes: 4.57 Lc31 on Willemstad Dark, 4.53 Lc36 on Twilight Violet, Lc40 on Zettlr Frankfurt Dark and Zettlr Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark.
verdicts.reason: primary is lifted only to 4.5 against editorBg, which leaves it just above the WCAG floor and APCA-weak on dark backgrounds.
verdicts.fix: Use the same dark-theme APCA floor as the muted-text finding, and apply it to primary when it is used as text.

verdicts.measured: color.ts:16 and :32 parse only #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, comma-separated rgb()/rgba() and oklch(). theme.schema.json:593-594 also accepts 4-digit hex, hsl()/hsla(), space-separated rgb, transparent and color-mix(). A grep finds none of those forms in any of the 26 repo themes.
verdicts.reason: Nothing shipped is affected today. A future theme or a user-made theme that uses those forms would skip both dark detection and the contrast lift.
verdicts.fix: Either extend parseRgba to hsl/hsla, #rgba and space/slash rgb, or narrow the schema pattern and README to the forms the parser accepts.

verdicts.measured: At rest, primaryForeground on primary passes WCAG but reads poorly: 4.51 Lc33 on Zettlr Berlin Light (#030305/#12865e) and Willemstad Dark (#090909/#567f83), 4.95 Lc39 on Twilight Violet, Lc41 on Zettlr Frankfurt Dark and Zettlr Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark. On hover (bg-primary/90 over popover, settings or editor) 11/28 themes drop under 4.5: 3.75 Zettlr Bielefeld Light, 3.83-3.97 Willemstad Dark and Zettlr Frankfurt/Karl-Marx-Stadt Dark, 4.16-4.48 Sakura, Twilight Violet and Tolaria Light. For comparison, white on #12865e is 4.57 Lc77.
verdicts.reason: ensureContrast nudges the author's primaryFg just to 4.5, which keeps black text on mid-tone fills. This is the same pattern as the badge bug fixed in aede19baa.
verdicts.fix: Pick primaryFg the way labelColors does: choose black or white by APCA and darken or lighten the primary fill so the text gets 4.5, with headroom so hover:bg-primary/90 still holds. This also fixes the kanban checked box, the selected calendar days and the hidden-tabs badge.

verdicts.measured: status-bar-fg on status-bar-bg is 4.50 Lc37 on KokoBrain Default, and 7/28 themes are under |Lc| 45. muted on popover: 7/28 under Lc 45 (KokoBrain Default 4.52 Lc44, Zettlr Dark Lc 39-40). tab-text-inactive: 5 Zettlr Dark themes at Lc 41-42.
verdicts.reason: Same root cause as the TasksView:902 finding: muted tokens are lifted to the bare 4.5 floor on dark themes.
verdicts.fix: Share the muted-text APCA floor fix with TasksView:902; no change in StatusBar.svelte itself is needed.

verdicts.measured: text-destructive fails 4.5 by surface: popover 12/28 (2.96 Lc26 Zettlr Bordeaux Dark, 3.02 Lc30 KokoBrain Default, 3.11 other Zettlr Dark, 3.97 Sakura); settings-dialog-bg 12/28 (3.01 Zettlr Dark, 3.08 KokoBrain Default, 4.16 Lavender Haze); setting-item-bg 12/28 (3.39 Zettlr Bordeaux Dark, 3.62 Willemstad Light, 3.66 Lavender Haze); editor-bg 10/28.
verdicts.reason: lift(p.error, 3) on editorBg only, yet text-destructive is used as small 12px text in about 60 places outside components/ui.
verdicts.fix: Lift error to 4.5 against every surface it is drawn on (editor, sidebar, panel, popover; settings surfaces map to these), or add a separate destructive-text token. This shares a fix with Todoist, the destructive menu item and READABILITY_PAIRS.

verdicts.measured: muted-foreground on --muted fails on 14/28 themes: 2.52 Lc27 Zettlr Bordeaux Dark, 2.58 the other Zettlr Dark themes, 3.68 Zettlr Light, 3.87 Twilight Violet, 4.20 Lavender Haze. The 'Text' badge (file-explorer-muted-fg) is 3.68 on Lavender Haze.
verdicts.reason: --muted is palette hover, and mutedFg is never checked against it. On Zettlr Dark the hover color is #505050.
verdicts.fix: Add mutedForeground vs muted to the lift surfaces and pairs, and fix the Zettlr hover color in the themes repo. Shares a fix with the Zettlr palette and READABILITY_PAIRS findings.

verdicts.measured: Traced, no shipped theme fails. theme.logic.ts:105-109 keeps every token from partial.ui verbatim and only fills missing tokens from the lifted derivation. The every-pair test (theme-builder.logic.test.ts:248) loops over BUILTIN_THEMES only.
verdicts.reason: This is a latent tooling gap. None of the shipped themes fail, and custom themes are the user's own choice.
verdicts.fix: Show the measured ratio in ThemeEditor and warn on import or save. Extend the every-pair test to the catalog packages, and add a contrast step to the themes repo's validate script.

verdicts.measured: muted on settings-hover-bg 15/28 (2.52 Zettlr Bordeaux Dark, 4.05 KokoBrain Default and Lavender Haze). primary on settings-hover-bg 17/28 (2.58 Zettlr Frankfurt Dark, 3.33 Zettlr Berlin Light). primary on setting-item-bg 6/28 (3.73 Sakura, 4.18 Lc30 Willemstad Dark). verdicts.measured: destructive on muted (hover) fails 19/28: 1.64 Lc14 Zettlr Bordeaux Dark, 1.72 other Zettlr Dark, 3.74 KokoBrain Default. muted on accent 11/28 (3.02 Zettlr Light, 3.70 Graphite Violet). primary on accent 11/28 (2.73 Zettlr Berlin Light).

verdicts.measured: Palettes read from the themes repo: dark hover = border = borderStrong = #505050, selected #282832; light hover = border #dcdcdc, selected = borderStrong #c8c8c8. verdicts.reason: The hover/selected fill is so far from the page color that no lifted muted text can meet 4.5 on it. Resting bg-muted chips in search results, Quick Switcher and settings are under 3:1.
verdicts.fix: In the themes repo, move the Zettlr hover and selected fills closer to editorBg, and lighten (dark themes) or darken (light themes) mutedFg. Combine this with the builder lift change.

verdicts.measured: On settings-dialog-bg, the error text (12px) fails on 12/28 themes: 3.01 Zettlr Berlin Dark, 3.08 KokoBrain Default, 3.89 Shimmering Focus Light. The token link at line 91 fails on 4/28: 4.15 Sakura, 4.19 Twilight Violet, 4.30 Shimmering Focus Light, 4.34 Willemstad Dark.
verdicts.reason: This is a usage instance of the destructive and primary lift gaps.
verdicts.fix: No local change needed; it is covered by the destructive-text and primary-on-settings lift in theme-builder.

verdicts.measured: White on bg-destructive at rest fails on 3/15 light themes: 4.13 Tolaria Light, 4.20 Shimmering Focus Light and Willemstad Light. On hover (/90) 4 light themes fail, down to 3.67 Tolaria Light. On dark, the /60 fill over popover gives 4.47 on Graphite Violet; over settings-dialog-bg all 13 dark themes pass.
verdicts.reason: The light-theme failures are real. The scout's suggested fix is wrong, though: destructiveForeground on the dark /60 fill fails on 8/13 dark themes (2.20 Willemstad Dark, 2.70 KokoBrain Default), because that token is computed against the opaque fill.
verdicts.fix: Drop dark:bg-destructive/60 and use text-destructive-foreground on the opaque bg-destructive, which passes 4.5 on 28/28. Alternatively keep white text and darken the destructive fill by APCA, the labelColors approach.

verdicts.measured: Input border (border-input = borderStrong) vs setting-item-bg is under 3:1 on 26/28 themes (1.06 Sakura, 1.08 Lavender Haze, 1.09 KokoBrain Default); vs popover 26/28 (1.24 KokoBrain Default). The input-bg fill vs the surrounding surface is 1.0-1.32 on 28/28. The KanbanCard.svelte:214 checkbox border at muted/40 on bg-background is 1.68-2.40 on 28/28; at full strength muted passes 28/28.
verdicts.reason: Neither the fill nor the border marks the control boundary. The PropertyField.svelte:126 part of the finding is refuted: it is a native checkbox with no appearance reset, so WebKit draws the system control and border-input has no effect.
verdicts.fix: Add a control-border token at 3:1 against setting-item-bg, popover and editor (or raise borderStrong for inputs only), and drop /40 on the Kanban checkbox border. Shares the token with the switch track finding.

verdicts.measured: Highlighted destructive item, text-destructive on destructive/20 over popover (dark) or /10 (light): fails on 18/28 themes. Dark: 2.56 Lc23 Zettlr Bordeaux Dark, 2.62 other Zettlr Dark, 2.63 Lc27 KokoBrain Default. Light: worst 3.48 Sakura, 4.42 Lavender Haze. context-menu-item.svelte:23 is the same.
verdicts.reason: The destructive selectors win over data-highlighted:bg-accent. Severity is medium rather than high because this is a transient highlight; at rest the same text is already 2.96-3.11 on popover, which is covered by the destructive-lift finding.
verdicts.fix: Keep the neutral accent highlight for destructive items, or lift the destructive text against the flattened tint. The builder change that lifts error to 4.5 also fixes the resting state.

verdicts.measured: The off track (switch-unchecked-bg = borderStrong) vs setting-item-bg is under 3:1 on 26/28 themes (1.06 Sakura, 1.12 Lavender Haze, 1.74 KokoBrain Default). The light-theme thumb (bg-background, line 26) has exactly the row color, because setting-item-bg = background = sidebarBg: 1.00 on 13/15 light themes, 1.21 Sakura, 1.24 Lavender Haze. The thumb vs track is 1.28-2.34 on 13/15 light themes.
verdicts.reason: On light themes the off switch is effectively invisible. On dark themes the off thumb is drawn in foreground and stays visible, so dark themes are lower risk.
verdicts.fix: Give the off track a 3:1 fill or border against setting-item-bg, and a light-theme thumb distinct from the row (for example a border, or a background different from sidebarBg). Add switchUncheckedBg vs settingItemBg at 3:1 to READABILITY_PAIRS. Shares the control-border token with the input finding.
